en: Theragāthā 3.4 Tikanipāta, Paṭhamavagga The Elder’s Verses 3.4 The Third Chapter: The Section of Threes, First Subsection I am one who has reached the goal; I am one who has done what was to be done. My mind is well-liberated through the destruction of craving. I have no more existence; I am now free from all bonds. I am a sage (muni) who has transcended all attachments. having regard for the state of a recluse;”
One who wishes to live happily should not despise what belongs to the Sangha: robes, food, and drink.
Having regard for the state of a recluse,
one should frequent lodgings and seats like a snake frequents a mouse-hole.
If one wishes to live happily,
having regard for the state of a recluse,
one should be content with whatever comes to hand.
